summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC furnished a Form 6-K disclosing completion on July 21, 2026 of its acquisition of Royal Uranium Inc. via a share exchange, first signed February 18, 2026 and amended June 11, 2026. The company issued 3,750,018 Class A ordinary shares (nominal $0.0035) for all 81,881,029 Royal Uranium shares, valuing Royal Uranium at $15,000,000 and making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Advisors received 95,000 Class A shares plus pre-funded warrants for 190,000 more. A prior 2025 restatement no longer reflects pro forma figures. Watch for revised pro forma disclosure and Uranium asset validation.
